title: Publish is a project decision: one bound remote per project, one Publish control, goals only report what landed
description:
Filed by session moe-next-67 for the owner (2026-09-04, human-directed: "Publish to git should be project based and not goal based"), sibling of the epic-8ebe6417 rows.

PRODUCT GAP, measured at main 68eb1c5d: `repository.publish` (PR #21, acf88616) is GOAL-scoped. Its payload is `["goalId", "remoteUrl"]` (apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:316), its aggregate is `publish:<goalId>` (apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-sequence.ts:114-118), the offer is minted per goal (apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:144), and the card on every opened goal asks the human to TYPE a git remote URL each time (apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/goal-publish.tsx: `cr.publish.remote` input, remembered only in localStorage). Yet the push itself is inherently project-level: the publisher pushes the WORKSPACE's current branch `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` (apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/node-publisher.ts), and the remote is a fact of the repository, which the daemon already binds with `project.bind_repository` (payload `["observation"]`). Seen live on UnAI 2026-09-04: the opened goal showed "PUBLISH - YOUR DECISION / No node of this goal is landed as a commit yet / Git remote (URL) https://github.com/you/your-repo.git" - a per-goal form for a per-project fact, rendered even with zero landed commits because the daemon offers the command regardless.

FEATURE: (a) a durable PROJECT remote: `repository.bind_remote {remoteUrl}` (operator-only, MCP-excluded, in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS) records the remote on a project aggregate (`remote:<projectId>`), validated the way goal-publish.tsx validates today (https:// or ssh, no embedded credentials); read back on `/resources/read` (or the resources read the control-room-completeness row adds) and on `/runs/read` as `project.remote`. (b) `repository.publish` drops `remoteUrl` from its payload (`["goalId"]` stays so the receipt names what was pushed; or becomes project-scoped `[]` - architect decides and states why), refuses `PUBLISH_REMOTE_UNBOUND` when no remote is bound, and is OFFERED only when at least one node of the goal carries a COMMITTED landing receipt (affordance-planning-offers.ts:144 gains that gate). (c) UI: ONE "Remote" setting on the project (Resources screen or the project boundary card), and the goal's publish card becomes a single Publish button that names the bound remote and the landed commits it will push; with no bound remote it links to the project setting; with nothing landed it renders nothing (the board header's publish link already keys on the offer). (d) The runbook "Publishing (your decision, your remote)" section and README publish clause rewritten to the project shape.

Roster backfill this touches (learned landing PR #21, memory prs19-22-landed-2026-09-03): daemon-command-vocabulary PAYLOAD_KEYS + BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY + OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS, mcp-tool-allowlist MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS, HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS, bootstrap-sequence prerequisites + aggregate ids, the seven hand-pinned roster tests (daemon-command-registry.test.ts ROWS/REGISTRATION_ORDER/size pins, daemon-command-vocabulary.test.ts, daemon-v2-command-registry.test.ts, mcp-main.test.ts, mcp-http-host.test.ts, daemon-command-registry-human-approver.test.ts, daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts snapshot), packages/contracts runtime-vocabulary + generated client regeneration + the four digest mirrors, tests/security layer census if a new *_LAYER constant is declared.
definitionOfDone: `repository.bind_remote` published operator-only, MCP-excluded, in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS, with the full roster backfill; a bidirectional roster test pins it; `REMOTE_URL_INVALID` (embedded credential, non-https/ssh) asserted with code + layer.

`repository.publish` no longer takes `remoteUrl`; with no bound remote it refuses `PUBLISH_REMOTE_UNBOUND` (code + layer asserted); the offer appears on `/affordances/read` only for a goal with >=1 COMMITTED landing receipt - a test shows the offer absent before the first landing and present after.

Publisher test: the push goes to the BOUND remote (argv asserted), and `moe-publish-receipt/1` names the remote it pushed to; the old per-goal `remoteUrl` field is gone from the decision payload and the receipt shape (exact-key roster updated).

UI: the project shows ONE remote setting with its bound value and a change control; the goal's publish card has no URL input (`cr.publish.remote` removed), names the bound remote and the landed commits, and renders nothing when nothing is landed; `localStorage` key `moe.publish.remoteUrl` no longer read or written (grep = 0). Playwright journey against a REAL daemon: bind remote -> land a node -> Publish -> receipt PUSHED.
docs/agent-stack-runbook.md Publishing section and the README publish clause rewritten to the project shape in the same commit.
Gates quoted with their count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:security`.

comments.author: architect-16a01670
comments.content:
PLANNING RECORD (architect-16a01670, 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d). MECHANISM: NO new command kind. `repository.bind_remote` would cost the PR #21 backfill (vocabulary + families + registry + v2 registry + MCP exclusion + bootstrap-sequence + 7 pinned roster tests + contracts runtime-vocabulary + generated client + 4 digest mirrors - about 20 files); `project.admin` is only a capability name and the configuration manifest is the provider profile, so no settings writer exists. Instead `repository.publish` keeps its EXACT payload roster ["goalId","remoteUrl"] (vocabulary.ts:316; enforced per registry entry :388) and `remoteUrl` becomes string|null: a URL binds (or rebinds) the project remote on `remote:<projectId>` in the same multi-leg decision as the publish request; null means the bound remote; nothing bound refuses PUBLISH_REMOTE_UNBOUND. The decision RESULT keeps {goalId, remoteUrl(resolved), requestedAt} so the wrapper publisher (node-publisher.ts:41-47), the receipt and the runs read are byte-identical.

DoD RE-ANCHORS (grade the measured truth): DoD 1 "repository.bind_remote published ..." -> the bind is a leg of repository.publish; the roster tests it would have touched stay unchanged; REMOTE_URL_INVALID only if its code-roster pins are <= 2 files, else the existing BOOTSTRAP_PAYLOAD_INVALID (child 1 states which). DoD 2 "no longer takes remoteUrl" -> the KEY stays (exact roster), the VALUE may be null; the offer gate on a COMMITTED landing is child 2. DoD 3 "remoteUrl gone from the decision payload and the receipt shape" -> the receipt keeps `remoteUrl` (it names the remote it pushed to, as the same clause demands); only the browser stops typing it. DoD 4 "ONE remote setting with a change control" -> the Health screen shows the bound remote (new read /repository/remote/read) and its Change control reveals the URL input on the publish card (a rebind happens with the next publish - documented); `moe.publish.remoteUrl` localStorage removed.

SPIDR-split into 3 children (parent = 0-file verification + live drive; dependsOn unsettable by an architect seat - step 1 manual gate): 1 daemon bind-on-publish + remote aggregate + remote read (leaf); 2 offer gate: repository.publish offered only with >= 1 COMMITTED landing (shares affordance-planning-offers.ts / affordance-read.ts with goal-close child task-8145137c - report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds while that row is WORKING); 3 control room (publish card without input when bound, Health "Repository" card, localStorage removal), Playwright, README/runbook. Ids follow.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) A new operator kind `repository.bind_remote` (as the row describes) - REJECTED: one kind costs the PR #21 backfill (vocabulary + families + registry + v2 registry + MCP exclusion + bootstrap-sequence + 7 pinned roster tests + contracts runtime-vocabulary + generated client + 4 digest mirrors, ~20 files) and cannot fit any child under the 10-file cap without a handler-less intermediate. (2) Storing the remote in the project configuration manifest - REJECTED: that manifest is the provider profile (packages/contracts/src/configuration/project-configuration-contract.ts:164-169) and `project.admin` is a capability name, not a writer. (3) CHOSEN: `repository.publish` keeps its exact payload roster; `remoteUrl` string binds/rebinds the project remote in the same multi-leg decision as the publish request, null resolves the bound one, unbound refuses PUBLISH_REMOTE_UNBOUND; the decision RESULT keeps {goalId, remoteUrl, requestedAt} so the wrapper publisher, the receipt and the runs read are byte-identical; a small additive read route serves the bound remote to the UI. (4) The offer gate on a COMMITTED landing shares two files with goal-close child task-8145137c - sequenced by blockedOnTaskIds, not by a cross-row dependsOn (the FULL VERTICAL SLICE rail forbids sibling dependsOn). (5) Change control - a dedicated command was rejected with (1); Change reveals the URL input and the next publish rebinds.
